gemini_description.purpose: To define general safety instructions, warning symbols, and safety regulations for the installation, operation, and maintenance of a pump system.
gemini_description.summary: This document outlines the meaning of safety symbols (electric shock, general danger, and equipment damage warnings) and provides general safety regulations, including power disconnection requirements, authorized modifications, and personnel qualification criteria.

components.name: Electric Shock Hazard Symbol
components.description: Represented by a lightning bolt inside a triangle. Warns of potential high-voltage exposure risks that can cause severe injury or death.

components.name: General Danger Symbol
components.description: Represented by an exclamation mark inside a triangle. Indicates risks that could cause personal injury or property damage.

components.name: Attention/Warning Symbol
components.description: Represented by an exclamation mark inside a square. Warns against practices that could cause physical damage to the pump or the installation.

components.name: Qualified Personnel
components.description: Authorized technicians who must thoroughly read and understand the installation and service instructions before conducting assembly or maintenance.

procedure: Read and understand the specific installation and service instructions prior to initiating any work.
Obtain prior approval from the manufacturer before implementing any modifications to the pump.
Verify that only manufacturer-approved spare parts and accessories are used to ensure safety.
Before starting any work on the pump or connected equipment, completely disconnect the pump from the electrical power supply and operating devices.
Execute assembly and maintenance tasks using only qualified and authorized personnel.
In the event of faulty operation or system malfunctions, immediately contact the supplier or the nearest distributor.

technical_details.detail: Electrical parts of the pump remain live during operation, necessitating complete isolation from the power supply before handling.
Safety and warranty compliance require strict adherence to the manufacturer's specific installation guidelines and approved parts list.

warnings.warning: Failure to comply with electric shock warnings poses a direct hazard to human life.
Non-compliance with safety instructions can cause personal injuries and extensive damage to surrounding property.
Unauthorized spare parts or accessories invalidate manufacturer liability for any resulting damages.
Working on the pump while it is connected to a live electrical supply is strictly prohibited.
